intent: Review the high-budget buyer-path content change. It connects the existing English corporate and brand service pages to the live RFP guide, expands the bilingual RFP guide for agency and event-planner procurement, and uses only the already published Healthy Smile project scope. Reject any unsupported capability, pricing, delivery, client-result, or bilingual-parity claim.
